vocab.sentence_chinese: 在聖誕派對上，學生們開心地交換禮物，度過了愉快的時光。

vocab.sentence: Many students attended the school ceremony yesterday.
vocab.sentence_chinese: 昨天有許多學生參加學校典禮。

vocab.sentence: The principal delivered an inspiring speech at the graduation ceremony.
vocab.sentence_chinese: 校長在畢業典禮上發表了一場激勵人心的演講。

vocab.sentence: The accident was caused by human error.
vocab.sentence_chinese: 這起事故是人為錯誤造成的。

vocab.sentence: The mailman delivers letters to the remote village in the mountains once a week.
vocab.sentence_chinese: 郵差每週一次將信件送到山中的偏遠村落。

vocab.sentence: More than one million people visit the city every year.
vocab.sentence_chinese: 每年有超過一百萬人造訪這座城市。

vocab.sentence: Drivers must follow the speed limits on this road.
vocab.sentence_chinese: 駕駛人必須遵守這條道路的速限。

phrases.chinese: 供你參考；告訴你（縮寫 FYI）
phrases.sentence: For your information, all our products come with a one-year warranty.
phrases.sentence_chinese: 告訴你，我們所有產品都附有一年保固。

cloze_quiz.question: A family get-together for dinner on Chinese New Year’s Eve is a very important ___ in Taiwan.
cloze_quiz.sentence_chinese: 在臺灣，除夕夜全家團聚吃晚餐是一項非常重要的習俗。
cloze_quiz.hint: 除夕夜全家團聚吃晚餐是一項傳統習俗，因此填 custom（風俗；習慣）。

cloze_quiz.question: At the Christmas party, students happily ___ gifts and had a good time.
cloze_quiz.sentence_chinese: 在聖誕派對上，學生們開心地交換禮物，度過了愉快的時光。
cloze_quiz.hint: 聖誕派對上互相交換禮物用 exchange gifts；後面的 had 表示過去的事情，因此填過去式 exchanged。

cloze_quiz.question: During the meeting, Robert and Jane had an ___ of ideas and discussed several important issues.
cloze_quiz.sentence_chinese: 會議期間，Robert 和 Jane 交流了想法，並討論了幾個重要議題。
cloze_quiz.hint: 後面提到討論重要議題，這裡是交流想法；an exchange of ideas 表示「意見交流」，exchange 在此是名詞。

cloze_quiz.question: What will you give to me in ___ for a ticket to Mayday’s concert next month?
cloze_quiz.sentence_chinese: 你會給我什麼，來換取一張五月天下個月演唱會的門票呢？
cloze_quiz.hint: 句子是在問用什麼換取演唱會門票；in exchange for 表示「交換……；換取……」，因此填 exchange。

cloze_quiz.question: Teresa waved her hand in ___ when her brother got out of the train station.
cloze_quiz.sentence_chinese: Teresa 的哥哥走出火車站時，她揮手向他打招呼。
cloze_quiz.hint: waved her hand 表示揮手，這裡是揮手打招呼；in greeting 表示「以示問候」，因此填 greeting。

cloze_quiz.question: Tony quickly exchanged ___ with Stella and then rushed to the classroom because he was already late.
cloze_quiz.sentence_chinese: Tony 迅速和 Stella 互相問候，接著趕往教室，因為他已經遲到了。
cloze_quiz.hint: Tony 和 Stella 互相打招呼；exchange greetings with someone 表示「和某人互相問候」，此處用複數 greetings。

cloze_quiz.question: David gathered his courage to invite Shirley to ___ the party with him, and she agreed.
cloze_quiz.sentence_chinese: David 鼓起勇氣邀請 Shirley 和他一起參加派對，而她答應了。
cloze_quiz.hint: invite Shirley 表示邀請 Shirley，邀請她一起「參加」派對用 attend the party；to 後接原形 attend。

cloze_quiz.question: The important meeting is scheduled for next Wednesday, and we hope that everyone can ___.
cloze_quiz.sentence_chinese: 這場重要會議訂於下週三舉行，我們希望每個人都能出席。
cloze_quiz.hint: 前面提到重要會議，這裡希望大家都能「出席」；can 後接原形動詞 attend。

cloze_quiz.question: At the graduation ___, a famous scholar delivered an inspiring speech, encouraging the students to pursue their dreams.
cloze_quiz.sentence_chinese: 在畢業典禮上，一位著名學者發表了振奮人心的演講，鼓勵學生追求自己的夢想。
cloze_quiz.hint: 學者在畢業活動中發表演講；graduation ceremony 表示「畢業典禮」，因此填 ceremony。

cloze_quiz.question: The professor demanded that Carl write his report again because there were too many ___ in it.
cloze_quiz.sentence_chinese: 教授要求 Carl 重寫報告，因為報告裡有太多錯誤。
cloze_quiz.hint: 教授要求重寫報告，原因是報告裡有太多「錯誤」；too many 後接複數可數名詞，因此填 errors。

cloze_quiz.question: After a thorough investigation, these experts concluded that the airplane crash mainly resulted from human ___.
cloze_quiz.sentence_chinese: 經過徹底調查後，這些專家認定這起墜機事故主要是人為疏失造成的。
cloze_quiz.hint: 專家調查墜機原因後認定是人為疏失；human error 表示「人為錯誤；人為疏失」，因此填 error。

cloze_quiz.question: The mailman ___ letters to the remote village in the mountains once a week.
cloze_quiz.sentence_chinese: 郵差每週一次將信件送到山中的偏遠村落。
cloze_quiz.hint: 郵差把信件送到村落，表示「投遞」，用 deliver；once a week 表示固定習慣，主詞 The mailman 是第三人稱單數，因此填 delivers。

cloze_quiz.question: It’s estimated that there will be more than one ___ people out of work due to this financial crisis.
cloze_quiz.sentence_chinese: 據估計，這場金融危機將造成超過一百萬人失業。
cloze_quiz.hint: one 後面需要表示人數的數量詞；one million people 表示「一百萬人」。million 前面有明確數字時不加 s。

cloze_quiz.question: It is amazing that this new sports car can run at a maximum ___ of 300 kilometers an hour!
cloze_quiz.sentence_chinese: 這輛新跑車的最高時速可達 300 公里，真是令人驚嘆！
cloze_quiz.hint: 300 kilometers an hour 表示每小時 300 公里，是速度；at a maximum speed of 表示「以最高……的速度」，因此填 speed。

cloze_quiz.question: Drivers must always pay attention to the ___ limits in different sections on the highway.
cloze_quiz.sentence_chinese: 駕駛人必須隨時注意高速公路不同路段的速限。
cloze_quiz.hint: 句子提醒駕駛注意高速公路各路段的限制；speed limits 表示「速度限制；速限」，因此填 speed。
